task.description: REWORK (iteration 1). TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (WF-02 Step 3b) ran `mix test test/letflow/routers/instances_test.exs` for real and got 41/44 passed, 3 failed -- all 3 in your own newly-split AC2 tests. 'AC2 level 2' (line 930), 'AC2 level 3' (line 948) and 'AC2 level 4' (line 966) each pass `actor_id: nil` to insert_raw_event!/2. That is not constructible against the real schema: lib/letflow/event_store/event.ex lists :actor_id in @required_fields, and priv/repo/migrations/20260816120001_create_events.exs:80 declares the column `null: false`. `Repo.insert(changeset, ...)` therefore returns `{:error, changeset}` with `actor_id: {"can't be blank", ...}`, and the helper's `assert {:ok, event} = Repo.insert(...)` fails before the test's own assertion is ever reached. Your gap-analysis (handoffs/WF02-REQ200-20260830/test-designer-gap-analysis.md) states this was a deliberate choice -- 'passing actor_id: nil explicitly for levels 2-4 rather than an actor_id that merely fails to resolve' -- but that input cannot be persisted, so the intent doesn't survive contact with the schema. The pre-restructuring combined test (git show b90a69b6:test/letflow/routers/instances_test.exs, the 'AC2/AC3: all four actor fallback levels resolve...' test) used `actor_id: Ecto.UUID.generate()` for levels 2-4 -- a real, syntactically valid, but unresolvable UUID -- and that is why it passed (SECURITY-REVIEWER's recorded 40/40 predates your restructuring). Fix: change levels 2, 3 and 4's `actor_id: nil` back to `actor_id: Ecto.UUID.generate()`. This still isolates each level correctly (a random UUID that matches no user row is 'no attributable actor' exactly as much as nil would be, and still cannot coincidentally satisfy a higher-priority fallback), and it is what a real event row on this schema actually looks like when there is no resolvable user -- level 1 (real actor_id) and AC3 (a real, once-existent, now-deleted user id) are unaffected and were not flagged. Everything else in your Step 3 pass verified clean and is not being reworked: AC1's seed data (4 distinct event types, confirmed by direct read), AC6's explicit refutes on both old field names, the AC7 ==1 tightening, no @tag :skip/pending or TODO-test anywhere, fixture isolation (unique slug_prefix per test throughout), and test/specs/REQ-200.md's per-AC documentation. Full FAIL detail in handoffs/WF02-REQ200-20260830/step-03b-test-design-validator.json's result block.
acceptance_criteria: Fix the 3 failing AC2 tests (levels 2, 3, 4) by replacing `actor_id: nil` with `actor_id: Ecto.UUID.generate()`, matching the pre-restructuring test's approach for an unresolvable-but-real actor id.
Do not change AC2 level 1, AC3, or any other test in the describe block -- only the 3 named tests' actor_id value.

Run `mix test test/letflow/routers/instances_test.exs` yourself (source ~/.asdf/asdf.sh) and quote the real result in this handoff before re-routing -- must be 44/44 (or the then-current full count), not assumed.
